correctness.rationale: The standard Artin–Schreier genus, exact finite tame fixed-point structure and Riemann–Hurwitz determine quotient genus. The degree-p map to u, local valuation equality at its unique infinity place, two explicit u=0 branches, and globally regular pole functions yield a candidate numerical semigroup whose Apéry gap count equals genus. Therefore the semigroup equality, minimal generators, conductor, type and every Riemann–Roch dimension follow. The standalone standard-library checker confirms 12 finite arithmetic cases, not the infinite geometric argument.
